challenge.title: Turn the audit around
challenge.prompt: Return order_id for orders with no matching customer, including orders with a NULL customer_id.
challenge.hint: Put orders on the left of the anti join. A NULL left key also makes NOT IN unknown.
challenge.starter: SELECT id AS order_id FROM orders WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM customers) ORDER BY id;
challenge.solution: SELECT o.id AS order_id FROM orders o ANTI JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY o.id;
challenge.success: Order 103 remains visible for review. The anti join tests whether a matching row exists; it does not need a non-NULL customer_id to preserve the order.
